brief: Six-channel ADC input driver for the Sense.ADC.6 tile.
description:
@version 1.1.0

Sense.ADC.6 turns six analog inputs into calibrated millivolt readings
served over I2C, so a host reads voltages instead of managing an ADC.
All sampling, filtering and timing happen on the tile. It sweeps the six
channels continuously at a paced rate and publishes a filtered set at a
configurable output rate, 100 Hz by default.

Every published set is coherent: all six channels come from the same
instant, never a mix of old and new, and each set carries a sequence
number so a host can tell a fresh reading from a repeat. Readings span
0 V to the tile's own supply, which the tile measures against its
internal reference once, at power-up, and uses as full scale. The
supply is readable too. A rail that moves after power-up is not
tracked; power the tile from a steady supply, or reset it after a change.

Channels map to pads in order:

  CH0 pad 2   CH1 pad 3   CH2 pad 6
  CH3 pad 7   CH4 pad 8   CH5 pad 9

Inputs accept source impedances up to roughly 30-50 kOhm (each
sample is taken over about 10 us); above that, add a buffer or an RC at
the input. CH1 and CH4 are the MCU's fast channels, specified down to
a 1.65 V supply; the others need at least 1.75 V. Output rate (1-250 Hz), sweeps
averaged per period (1-32) and filter-window length are all settable at
runtime and can be stored on the tile to survive a reboot.


Output rate and filtering are configurable at runtime. The averaging
window doubles as mains rejection, because a boxcar over N periods
nulls every multiple of rate/N:

  100 Hz, window 1   default, 10 ms average
  100 Hz, window 2   20 ms average, nulls 50 Hz
  120 Hz, window 2   16.7 ms average, nulls 60 Hz
   10 Hz, window 1   100 ms average, nulls both

The default (100 Hz, window 1) passes 50 Hz at only -3.9 dB, so pick
a rejection setting if the sensor leads can pick up mains.

Several tiles share a bus. Each needs its own address, stored on the
tile with tile_sense_adc_6_set_address(), which takes effect at its
next power-up. Instances 0-3 are 0x28-0x2B; any other address is
reached with cfg.address. Read the settings back any time: they are live values,
not a copy of what you asked for.

Poll a little faster than the output rate and use the sequence number
to spot repeats, since the tile's clock and yours drift apart by a
percent or so.

@studio tile label=Sense.ADC.6 icon=∿

@studio unsupported severity=common category="Raw counts / ratiometric output" section=runtime
  Readings are calibrated millivolts only. For a divider powered from
  the tile's own rail, a ratio of full scale would cancel supply
  variation exactly and be more accurate than millivolts. Needs a
  format setting on the tile.

@studio unsupported severity=advanced category="Sampling-time control" section=config
  The ADC's per-sample acquisition time is fixed. Exposing it would
  let high-impedance sources (above ~50 kOhm) settle properly.

@studio unsupported severity=advanced category="Data-ready output" section=events
  No interrupt line: every pad is taken by the six inputs, the bus and
  power, so a host must poll. Reading the sequence number tells you
  whether a set is new.

@studio unsupported severity=niche category="Synchronized sampling across tiles" section=advanced
  Each tile free-runs on its own clock, so several tiles on one bus
  drift apart by a percent or so and their samples are not aligned in
  time. An I2C general-call latch would fix it.

@studio unsupported severity=niche category="Per-channel enable" section=config
  All six channels are always sampled. Disabling unused ones would
  shorten each sweep and save power.

defines.name: SENSE_ADC_6_SWEEPS_MAX
defines.description: oversamp x window, the tile's sample ring

defines.name: SENSE_ADC_6_SWEEP_HZ_MAX
defines.description: rate x oversamp, sweeps per second

structs.name: sense_adc_6_cfg_t
structs.brief: Optional init config. Pass NULL for defaults.
structs.description:
Any field left zero keeps the tile's stored setting, so a tile
configured once and saved comes up the same way without the host
having to restate it.

fields.name: address
fields.description: override the address for this instance, 0 = default

fields.name: oversamp
fields.description: sweeps averaged per period, 0 = leave as stored

fields.name: window
fields.description: periods averaged (1 or 2), 0 = leave as stored

params.name: instance
params.description: Device instance (0-3, selects the default addresses)

functions.brief: Check whether a tile is present.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_find

functions.signature: void tile_sense_adc_6_init(tiles_pal_t *hal, uint8_t instance, tile_t *tile, const sense_adc_6_cfg_t *cfg)
functions.description:
Verifies the tile's identity and reads its current settings. Applies
any rate/oversamp/window given in cfg; otherwise leaves the tile's
stored settings alone.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_init

functions.return: 1 on success, 0 if the read failed
functions.brief: Fetch one coherent set of readings from the tile.
functions.description:
One bus transaction collects all six channels, the status and the
sequence number from the same instant. Call this, then read the
channels with read_mv(), which costs no bus traffic.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_update

params.name: ch
params.description: [0..5] Channel. CH0 is pad 2, CH1 pad 3, CH2 pad 6, CH3 pad 7, CH4 pad 8, CH5 pad 9.

functions.return: Millivolts, or 0 if the channel is out of range
functions.brief: Millivolts on one channel, from the last update().
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_read_mv

functions.brief: Copy all six channels from the last update() into an array.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_read_all

functions.brief: Sequence number of the last set, which advances once per output period and wraps at 255.
functions.description:
Unchanged between two updates means you polled faster than the tile
publishes, not that it stopped.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_sequence

functions.brief: True when the last set is current: sampling is running and settled after any settings change.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_is_valid

functions.brief: Status bits (SENSE_ADC_6_ST_*) from the last update().
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_status

functions.brief: The tile's measured supply in millivolts, which is also the full-scale input voltage.
functions.description: Measured by the tile once, at its power-up; the driver reads it at init.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_supply_mv

functions.signature: uint8_t tile_sense_adc_6_set_rate(tile_t *tile, uint8_t rate_hz, uint8_t oversamp, uint8_t window)

params.name: window
params.description: [1..2] Output periods averaged. 2 halves the null frequency.

functions.description:
Applied as a set, because the three only make sense together. The
tile restarts acquisition within a few milliseconds; readings are
marked invalid until the filter has refilled (window output periods),
so you never average across the change. Live only: save() stores it.

Limits: oversamp x window at most 32 sweeps, and rate x oversamp at
most 8000 sweeps per second. Out-of-range combinations are rejected
(without touching the bus) and the tile keeps running as it was.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_set_rate

functions.brief: The tile's current output rate in Hz.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_get_rate

functions.brief: Store the current settings on the tile so they survive a power cycle.
functions.description:
Stores the live rate, oversamp and window, plus the address staged for
the next power-up (unchanged unless set_address() staged a new one).
Writes the tile's non-volatile memory, which holds the bus for up to
about 30 ms and only writes what actually changed. Do it on a bench,
not while other tiles are being polled on the same bus.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_save

functions.return: 1 if stored, 0 if rejected or the write failed
functions.brief: Give the tile a new I2C address, stored permanently.
functions.description:
For several tiles on one bus. The new address takes effect at the
tile's NEXT POWER-UP, not immediately, so this handle keeps working
until then. Address one tile at a time: they all ship on the same
default address, so give each its own before putting them on a shared
bus. Storing the address also stores the current rate settings, as
save() does.
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_set_address

functions.return: Pad number, or 0 if the channel is out of range
functions.brief: The pad number a channel is wired to (CH0 is pad 2, and so on).
functions.name: tile_sense_adc_6_channel_pad

vibe_rules.message: Sweeps per period times the averaging window can't exceed 32, the size of the tile's sample buffer. Lower one of them.
Output rate times sweeps per period can't exceed 8000 sweeps a second. Lower the rate or the sweeps per period.
